data: In fiscal 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, Apple reported total net sales of about $383.3 billion, down roughly 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was about $169.1 billion, a gross margin of roughly 44.1%, up from about 43.3% in fiscal 2022. Within that, products carried a gross margin of about 36.5% and services about 70.8%. Operating income was about $114.3 billion, an operating margin of roughly 29.8%, slightly below the 30.3% Apple posted in fiscal 2022. Operating expenses rose to about $54.8 billion, which partly offset the higher gross margin.
